findings.title: A subscription added by hand in a foreign currency reads "≈ RM0.00" and adds nothing to "Committed each month"
findings.detail: Add a subscription takes USD, SGD, EUR and GBP, but the row's ringgit estimate is `displayFxRate ? fxApprox(...) : 0` (data/fake/views.ts:817), and a hand-added subscription has no rate yet. So US$999.99 a month shows "≈ RM0.00" and the commitment stays RM141.90. The spec says the rate is Bank Negara's middle rate, shown as "≈ RM40.88 · BNM 7 Oct" (§11); with no rate the row should say so ("rate arrives tomorrow"), and the total should not quietly leave it out. It is the first thing the owner will try with the new button.
findings.repro: Dev server or preview: /s/subscriptions -> Add a subscription -> Name Spotify US, USD, amount keys 9 9 9, next renewal any date -> Save. Run: `playwright test -c b04r.config.ts b04r-r4-flowsI` (red on purpose).

findings.title: D133's hand tick is built nowhere and is in no brief
findings.detail: D133 and spec §10 say a payday move is ticked by its notification or by hand (Done), booking the transfer deduped by its plan step.
